RRA.Title: Read chat aloud
RRA.MenuHint: Turn reading on or off, pick the voice and speed.
RRA.Hint: Reads chat lines aloud on this computer only.
RRA.VoiceHint: Open Foundry in Edge for natural voices (✦).
RRA.Sample: Ezren, we're short on coin, so we head for the first town we see.
RRA.Keys: Keys: Alt+S stop · Alt+R repeat · Alt+T on/off. Headphones recommended.
RRA.NoVoices: Looking for voices… (open this again in a moment)

enabled.Name: Read chat aloud
enabled.Hint: Reads typed chat lines aloud. This computer only.

speaker.Name: Speaker's name
speaker.Hint: Whether to say who is speaking before the line.

catchUp.Name: Catch up when behind
catchUp.Hint: Reads faster when lines pile up; skips the oldest if far behind.

allVoices.Name: Show voices in every language
allVoices.Hint: Off: only voices that read Korean, plus English and Japanese.

autoCast.Name: Give characters without a voice one of their own
autoCast.Hint: Gives each voiceless character a fixed voice and pitch. Off: default voice.

Bind.repeat: Read aloud: say the last line again

Cast.Title: Character voices
Cast.Hint: Set a voice and pitch per character (pitch only on voices without ✦).
Cast.None: No characters yet. The party and whoever speaks in chat show up here.
Cast.Drop: Drop an actor on this window to add it.
Cast.ShareHint: Saves this list as everyone's default. Personal choices come first.
Cast.Shared: Saved {n} character voices as everyone's default.
Cast.Sample: This is {name}. I'll read with this voice.

RRA.NeedClick: Read aloud: click the page once to start.
